events.name: pre_tool
events.note: Per tool call, before the permission prompt; match is a tool-name glob or re: regex, case-insensitive, default *.

events.name: post_tool
events.note: Per tool call, only if the tool body ran; same matcher; can replace or append to the output text.

events.name: post_agent
events.note: Once per turn after the agent stops with no pending tool calls; no matcher; deny forces a retry, max 3.

command.note: Unique hook id; a project hook wins over a user hook with the same name.

Tool-name matcher, glob or re: regex, case-insensitive; tool hooks only, default * in code.
Seconds before the whole process tree is killed.
Tool hooks only: any failure denies the call (pre_tool) or clears the output (post_tool).
